verdict.rationale: Fly's docs reference provisioning Postgres via flyctl/fly launch, implying managed database support, but the evidence pack contains no documentation confirming point-in-time recovery, replica, or HA automation. Multiple community reports describe Postgres machines going down together with no automatic failover, Fly's own incident response recommending users run multiple instances themselves to mitigate host failures, and setup guides producing broken Postgres links—contradicting the 'fully-managed HA' claim.
